meta.face: Peter as on the peter card: about sixty-five, a broad, weathered fisherman's face, a strong wide nose, deep-set earnest eyes, a lined forehead; curly grey-white hair balding from the back with a curly tuft at the forehead; a short, square, curly grey-white beard; a steady, fatherly gaze toward the viewer. Paul as on the paul card: about sixty, a noble LONG face — a high domed forehead, bald on top with dark wavy hair greying at the sides, a straight fine nose, calm luminous dark eyes, a long dark pointed beard streaked with grey reaching well below the chin; eyes lifted, thoughtful. The two faces must stay clearly different: Peter broad, square-bearded and grey-white; Paul long, bald-domed and dark-bearded.
meta.basis: The feast keeps the dedications of the Vatican basilica and of St. Paul's on the Via Ostiense, both built over the Apostles' tombs; showing each Apostle carrying his church follows the founder-with-model convention and the recognisable forms of the two buildings. Faces and dress continue the `peter` and `paul` cards.
